ai.consent.title: How the assistant uses your data
ai.consent.intro: Please read this before using the assistant. Nothing is sent until you agree.
ai.consent.provider_body: The assistant uses a third-party AI service to answer your questions: {{provider}}. The data below is sent to this service.
ai.consent.sent_body: What you type and the earlier messages of the same chat, plus your name, your role and your business name.
ai.consent.records_body: The business records the assistant looks up to answer: customer names, phone numbers, plates, jobs, amounts, account and cash balances, products and stock, todos.
ai.consent.not_sent_body: Your password, your session details and other data on your device are not sent. When the assistant proposes a change, nothing changes until you confirm it.
ai.consent.control_body: You can withdraw this permission at any time under Profile → Preferences. You can delete your chats from the assistant screen.
ai.consent.footnote: If you don't agree, the assistant stays off; the rest of the app isn't affected.
ai.consent.prefs_given: You allowed data sharing with {{provider}} on {{date}}. If you withdraw it, the assistant won't send messages until you agree again.
ai.consent.prefs_none: The first time you open the assistant you'll see what is shared and be asked for permission.
ai.consent.revoked: Data sharing for the assistant withdrawn
account.legal.privacy_subtitle: What data we collect, how we use it and how long we keep it
account.legal.login_notice: By signing in you agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
account.legal.delete_hint: The Privacy Policy explains which records are kept, on what legal basis and for how long.
account.legal.ai_hint: The assistant's full data processing terms are in the Privacy Policy.
